scopeNotes: Source Excel rows are globally de-duplicated first; repeated identical package/economics copies within an architecture product are collapsed, while explicitly distinct multi-month commercial packages are added separately under the locked multi-month rule.

Rows carrying per-unit/per-each/per-mL costs without a verified customer dispense quantity retain the source unit cost only; package model retail/profit/margin fields are null and excluded from aggregates.
Model averages are simple unweighted averages across complete unique medication packages; memberships, provider services, and accessories are excluded.
Current website and Tagada prices are attached only on exact/confident SKU/package joins; no pharmacy/formulation substitution was made.

methodology.suggestedPriceRounding: Monthly packages: nearest whole-dollar price ending in 9, equidistant up. Multi-month packages: locked rule rounds monthly customer price first, multiplies by months, then rounds to nearest $X9. No suggestion when quantity/source is unresolved.

rationale: Model A averages 35.63% raw gross margin across 62 complete packages, but its lowest complete-package margin is 20.0% and 12 packages fall below 30% before provider, processing, carrier, or operating costs.
Model B raises the same unweighted average to 42.37%, but suggested retail rises by more than $20 on 14 packages and by $11–$20 on 23 packages.

The numbers support evaluating a targeted ×2 or minimum-margin floor before a blanket move; a final decision requires target margin, sales mix, demand sensitivity, provider, processor, carrier, and operating-cost inputs.

Do not change $149 SEM or $275 TIR memberships from this audit; their lowest documented medication-only margins remain positive, but true margins cannot be finalized until provider, processor, carrier, and operating costs are supplied.
Resolve incomplete package economics and the 16 unresolved medication catalog entries before implementing any broad pricing rule.
